description: Feature flag 'enable_new_auth_flow' enabled in production config for 50% of users. New auth flow has a broken OAuth token refresh path causing login failures for half of users. No code deploy — config change only.

known_root_cause.description: Feature flag 'enable_new_auth_flow' set to 50% rollout via ConfigMap update (not a code deploy). The new auth flow's OAuth token refresh path calls refresh_token() with incorrect parameter order — refresh_token(client_id, token) instead of refresh_token(token, client_id). Affects ~50% of users deterministically by user_id hash.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Feature flag enable_new_auth_flow at 50% rollout — new auth flow has parameter order bug in refresh_token(). Config change, not code deploy. Disable flag to remediate.

logs.message: Feature flag config updated: enable_new_auth_flow = 50% (was 0%). Rolling out to production.
No code deployment. Config map updated via kubectl apply. Pods reloaded flags.
New auth flow active for 48% of incoming sessions (expected ~50%).
TypeError: refresh_token() got unexpected keyword argument. Expected (token, client_id), received (client_id, token). User: 88821. Flag: enable_new_auth_flow=true.
POST /auth/token/refresh failed: TypeError — 500 returned. New auth flow path.
POST /auth/token/refresh succeeded. User: 12044. Flag: enable_new_auth_flow=false. Legacy path unaffected.
TypeError: refresh_token() argument order mismatch. User: 77291. enable_new_auth_flow=true.
GET /users/profile succeeded. User: 33190. Flag: enable_new_auth_flow=false. Legacy path healthy.
Pattern: all errors originate from enable_new_auth_flow=true code path. Legacy path (enable_new_auth_flow=false) has 0 errors.
user-service /auth/token/refresh returning 500 for ~50% of requests. Non-deterministic from gateway perspective.
Error rate pattern correlates exactly with feature flag assignment. No errors from flag=false users in last 90s.
Error rate 48%. Datadog alert firing. Last code deploy was 6 hours ago. Config change 3 minutes ago.
Stack trace (new auth flow): TokenRefreshHandler.handle (auth/token.py:201) -> OAuthClient.refresh_token (oauth/client.py:88) -> TypeError
Note: no matching errors in payment-service or order-service. Issue isolated to auth token refresh path.
